scope: existing all1000 pilot per process; native flavour diagnostic, no physical recalibration or stitching
model: frozen Phase6D conditional tag model and persisted selections

two_tags.concentration_scope: (sum q)^2/sum(q^2) is a yield-concentration diagnostic, not a count of independent events
two_tags.weight_information_scope: weight dispersion only, without rare acceptance; positive-equal original weights yield N=1000
two_tags.precision_information_scope: inverse estimated squared relative error; separate pilot/tag meanings; not extra events, calibrated significance or validated precision

leading_pair_decomposition.scope: categories are mutually exclusive per original tag outcome; off-diagonal conditional covariance=-sum(r_a*r_b); sum all covariance entries for total variance, never sum diagonals alone

event_tag_origin_decomposition.scope: categories are mutually exclusive per original tag outcome; off-diagonal conditional covariance=-sum(r_a*r_b); sum all covariance entries for total variance, never sum diagonals alone

leave_one_out_diagnostic.interpretation: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: original all-event result remains authoritative; neither subtraction nor the rescaled remaining-event mean is a corrected physical prediction
